boundary: Same process, exact separately imported backend graphs, alternate before/after trial order. Each corpus lives in its own generated Git repository under workspace filesystem. Fresh handle is not physical cold; OS page cache is not dropped. Scan receipts are exact full bounded-tool receipts, including truncation; dense may stop early. Initial missing occurs before preparation, separately charged. One caller-paid preparation shared by dense/sparse/miss; missing cases run dense/sparse/miss in fixed order. Prepared memory queries follow preparation; restartDisk creates fresh Truth/View/adapter/store handles per pattern. Every query and preparation records own delta counters. Source/stat/I/O counts are mechanism evidence; timings are machine-local, with no universal 50ms claim. Refused entropy preparation falls back, and no default activation is implied.
